description: This file defines a Java interface 'ExecQueryCallbackFunctionIF' with a single method 'processNextRow' used for processing rows in a SQL ResultSet.

classes.name: ExecQueryCallbackFunctionIF
classes.description: A Java interface for defining callback functions that process rows from a SQL ResultSet.

methods.name: processNextRow
methods.description: Processes the next row in the ResultSet and returns true if successful or false if no more rows are available.
